content:
My internet suddenly stopped working yesterday, so today's upload is going to be a little later than usual. 😭

The artwork I uploaded yesterday had already been prepared in advance, so I was able to upload it using my phone. However, today's work was delayed because of the internet issue.

Thankfully, the repair technician just finished fixing the problem, and my internet is back up now!

I'll start working on today's upload again and try to upload it late tonight. Depending on how things go, though, it may be uploaded tomorrow instead.

I'm sorry to everyone who has been waiting. 😭I'll do my best to upload it as soon as possible!

title: 📢 Vote on the Upload Format
content:
Recently, I tried uploading two artworks using a new format that is different from the previous Upload Images + Extra Images format, where I uploaded Upload Images only.

After trying this format, I’m considering officially changing the upload format starting in October.

What do you think?

Extra Images are basically additional images that are created as a byproduct of the process while working on the Upload Images.

Current format:・Upload Images + Extra Images・Regular: 160+ images・Request works: 200+ images

New format:・Upload Images only・Regular: 140+ images・Request works: 180+ images

However, unlike the Extra Images, I spend additional time and put more effort into the quality of the Upload Images, so each artwork takes a little longer to complete.

With the current format, I upload around 4–5 artworks per week, while with the new format, I expect to upload one artwork every two days, or around 3–4 artworks per week.

Which format would you prefer?

最近、これまでの 「Upload Images + Extra Images」 という形式とは違い、「Upload Images」のみをアップロードする新しい形式で、2作品を試しに投稿してみました。

この形式を実際に試してみた上で、10月から正式にアップロード形式を変更しようかと考えています。

皆さんはどう思いますか？

Extra Images は、Upload Imagesを制作する過程でできる、いわば副産物のような追加画像です。

現在の形式：・Upload Images + Extra Images・通常：160枚以上・リクエスト作品：200枚以上

変更後の形式：・Upload Imagesのみ・通常：140枚以上・リクエスト作品：180枚以上

ただし、Upload ImagesはExtra Imagesとは違い、別途より多くの時間をかけてクオリティにも力を入れて制作しているため、1作品を完成させるまでに少し時間がかかります。

現在の形式では週に4～5作品程度をアップロードしていますが、変更後の形式では2日に1作品程度、つまり週に3～4作品程度のアップロードを予定しています。

皆さんはどちらの形式が良いと思いますか？

ぜひ投票をお願いします！
